card: A call you can find and listen to later.
title: CallVault for the calls worth finding
intro: CallVault gives an Android call a place in your phone library, where you can play it back, add a note and find it again.

sections.heading: What does CallVault record?
sections.body: On Android, the recording depends on the audio source your phone makes available.

sections.heading: How do you find a call later?
sections.body: The phone library lets you play, search, add notes and export. A detail is easier to return to when it has a place.

sections.heading: Where are recordings kept?
sections.body: They remain on your phone unless you choose private cloud backup.

sections.heading: Where does CallVault fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps the people and moments around a call. CallVault keeps the Android recording itself in a phone library you can search.
